summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container; nothing was run and nothing committed. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds class Update(prologue, algebra) beside Query. rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns Update; the empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] with base and initNs before returning an empty algebra; the non-empty path returns Update(prologue, res); Update imported from sparql.py. rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, setting _original_args. rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. New test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers prepare-and-apply, reuse across graphs, initNs resolution, direct evaluation, initial bindings, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty strings, and a no-mutation check via (name, str(op)) snapshots. Unverified: tests and DAWG tests were not run; black formatting was checked by hand only. Least certain test: the initial-bindings test relies on the empty-BGP path yielding the initial-binding solution.
